## Read the comparison

A useful report keeps the number, its unit and its context together. This specimen compares headings, body type, a metric and one table row.

```metric
value: 8.4
label: Annualized deaths per 1,000, April 1854
```

```table
title: A row of observations
data: { inline: [{ month: Apr, rate: 8.4 }] }
columns:
  - { key: month, label: Month }
  - { key: rate, label: Rate, format: number }
```

*Source: Nightingale's mortality record, April 1854; rates sum across causes.*
